entries: Define the goal｜check outcomes, scope, deadlines, and acceptance criteria with the client and stakeholders｜clarify ambiguity first.
Break down the plan｜list work packages, dependencies, personnel, budget, and risks｜the baseline requires approval.
Start execution｜assign responsibilities and time points to the team｜check the technical lead's commitment.
Track progress｜collect actual completion, cost, and blocking information｜do not equate a report with real completion.
Manage changes｜assess scope, time, cost, and quality impact｜send to authorized personnel for decision.
Acceptance and review｜check deliverables, open items, and lessons against the agreed criteria｜file versions and approvals.

description.text: Project management specialists coordinate project scope, schedule, personnel, procurement, budget, and delivery. See the O*NET 13-1082 tasks, 2025 United States wages, the BLS 2025–2035 projection, the Chinese wage gap, and the fictional entry exercises.

subject.name: Project management specialists
subject.summary: Project management specialists analyze and coordinate scope, schedule, procurement, personnel, and budget for a single project, lead the technical team to complete milestones and deliverables, and confirm goals, changes, and acceptance with the client and stakeholders. The position is responsible for making decisions traceable, and authority and final sign-off follow the organizational agreement.
